reviewOutcome: Local cadastral procedure is evidenced, but no qualifying public parcel-polygon service or safe retained geometry sample was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: English and Japanese first-party discovery was performed and recorded in the city record. Kochi City cadastral-survey, cadastral-result, parcel-reference-map, and FY2026 public-GIS budget pages were inspected. A discovered ArcGIS 地番図 service responded anonymously, but metadata showed a point layer and an extent around 140°E rather than Kochi; its bounded Kochi query returned zero features. This was rejected as a Kochi parcel source.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Kochi City Cadastral Survey Division and Asset Tax Division are evidenced as local custodians/procedure owners by first-party pages. The inspected ArcGIS service is not attributed to Kochi City and is not accepted.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: The rejected ArcGIS candidate advertises EPSG:3857 service/layer metadata and EPSG:4326 output capability, but its geometry type is point rather than polygon. Kochi City source pages did not expose a current public parcel schema or CRS.
uncertainty: No public city-bounded parcel geometry was verified. The absence of a hit in the rejected candidate is not evidence of citywide absence; the exact WUP point was preserved without shifting it.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. No registry/catalog/runtime files were changed.
